meta.label: MEASURED — building density within 10km of each branch (Overture footprints)
meta.provenance: source-data/perimeter_counts.json, pipeline/refresh_perimeter_counts.py — counts from the 77 in-repo province-wide Overture catchments (2026-07-20 pull, capped 180k/province). Method: per province: bin catchment building centroids into 0.1-degree grid; count within 10km of each branch; branch->province by Thai name join
caveats: MEASURED — building count within 10km (equirect) of each branch, from the province-wide catchment pulls (capped 180k buildings/province; most large provinces hit the cap, so counts near dense cores are FLOORS, not totals). A zero means the capped catchment has no buildings there; border branches only see their own province's buildings.

perimeter_counts.json predates the branches_fingerprint convention and carries no per-record identity field; index alignment against the CURRENT branches.json was manually verified (fingerprint continuity since commit dda7816, 2026-07-02) before this builder was written — see docs/DATA_REFRESH_LOG.md.
